CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.whatWasStillWrongAtBase: The ellipsis half of the VF01 finding was already gone at a60a1237b: this lane re-read both delivered fixtures and found no ellipsized value anywhere, and every multiline value inside its widget box. What remained was the mechanism the assignment named. Each delivered fixture carried 443 flattened Form XObjects, of which 91 were stroke-only - each one '0 0 0 RG', '0 w', a single closed four-segment path, 'S', and no text operator - one for every check-box widget the route does not tick, plus one wrapping the widget for item 12 which it does tick.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.whyItIsADefect: None of that ink comes from the official form. All 94 Illinois check-box widgets carry an /AP /N dictionary holding only their on state (/Yes or /No) and no /Off entry, which is how a form says an unticked box draws nothing. pdf-lib reads that absence as a missing appearance - PDFCheckBox.needsAppearancesUpdate() returns true whenever a widget's /AS is absent from /AP /N - so form.updateFieldAppearances() replaced every check box's appearance streams with its own: an /Off state stroking a hairline rectangle around the whole widget /Rect, and an on state discarding the form's ZapfDingbats mark for a 1.5 w drawn check. The form's own empty box is a glyph, not the widget rectangle: on Request page 1 the printed box is a 12 pt glyph on a baseline at y=343.5, while the widget /Rect spans x=71.9114..84.0799, y=341.175..353.179, so pdf-lib's square prints as a second, larger, offset hairline box around the printed one. VF03 and VF04 scored 19 and 20 of these as visualDefects from a raster.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.repair: scripts/build-census-v1-il-seal-2yr-set.mjs: preserveOfficialCheckBoxAppearances() installs the /Off appearance the official form omits - an empty Form XObject the size of the widget - on all 94 check-box widgets before any field is touched, which makes needsAppearancesUpdate() false so pdf-lib regenerates nothing; form.flatten() is now called with { updateFieldAppearances: false } so the flatten cannot re-synthesize. No participant fact is written and no ink is added; ink the source never authored is removed.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.evidence: inkWithoutGlyphs() on the pre-repair committed bytes: 91 on canonical (a099347fd0f56bc771df70549a69d67d9da505e1e74a76dd5dae1afcdbe7c096) and 91 on boundary (bd75164956cdf709a5202af164e51ccd662bd0dcf166f94a9134bfe550760612). On the delivered bytes after the repair: 0 and 0. Ticked boxes are unchanged in meaning and now carry the official form's own ZapfDingbats mark: item 12 Yes on Request page 4, Section 17 on page 5, the self-represented box on Request page 6 and on the fee-waiver signature page.
CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.notMeasurableHere: Whether any residual overlap survives on the rendered page. That needs a raster this container cannot perform.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.verdict: PART ALREADY SOUND, PART REPAIRED BY THIS LANE, ONE PART STOPPED
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.alreadySound: VF02 found the guide omitted the ISP statewide transcript, both outcome-comparison steps, the per-case election and the post-objection hearing date. FIX13 made the builder read track.packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling and print all ten lines verbatim, and its self-test fails the build if any line is missing. This lane confirmed all ten by exact string containment against data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json tracks[trackId=il-seal-3yr]: the transcript, both comparison lines, the certified dispositions, the signature and verification, the wet-signature expectation, the expunge-versus-seal election, the hearing date, the fee and the Rule 298 waiver.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.stillWrongAtBase: The builder's own operative sentence around those lines was wrong. It read: 'For each case, make the per-case expunge-or-seal election in the Case List's per-case election column, which is where the record places it -- not on the Request.' That column does not exist. This lane enumerated the blank official ATJ 2902.1 Case List independently: 78 AcroForm fields - 1 dropdown (county), 76 text fields (five caption fields, '7 - Case Number', and arrest1 through arrest70), 1 check box ('Page 1 - More Arrests or Case Numbers'). There is no election field of any kind. The sentence sent the filer to a column that is not on the form and, worse, away from where this packet did make the election: Request item 12 and the Section 19 limb.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.repair: The builder's own sentence now states the discrepancy and points at the Request: it says the record places the election in a Case List per-case election column, that the official Case List carries no such column and what its 78 fields actually are, that this packet made the election on the Request at item 12 and the Section 19 limb, and that a wrong election is corrected on the Request rather than on the Case List. The record's line is still printed verbatim above it - the record is quoted, not edited.
REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.stopped: The controlling record itself still says 'Expunge-versus-seal selection for each case - Case List, per-case election column', and IL.memo.json's manualCompletionItems say the same. Correcting a controlling legal record is not this lane's to make, and the same line reaches il-seal-2yr-set and il-exp-qualprob-set, over which this lane holds no REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING grant. It needs an owner of data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json and data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/IL.memo.json to decide whether the record is corrected to name the Request, or the discrepancy is ratified as a known form-versus-record divergence.
